originality.rationale: The inspected primary papers define the preconditional framework without this height-three coatom-extension census. Published finite-chain and prior height-two diamond claims have different carrier hypotheses; the previous partial-matching count lacks the coatom choices and does not imply weighted F_m nor the new T_m and orbit formulas. Dedicated searches found no stronger general ordinal-sum theorem covering the statement. Residual unindexed-literature and earlier general-theorem priority risk is expressly retained.

value.rationale: The complete infinite family of natural height-three coatom extensions is not covered by chain or height-two classifications. Its extra layer creates genuine cross-row constraints and a two-colour unmatched-atom structure, yielding new exact T/F formulae, an EGF and a complete automorphism-orbit spectrum. This addresses the algebraic distinction between the T and F logical semantics on the first nontrivial ordinal height extension, rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
